title: 농장 불량 및 부서별 피드백 추적
qualityIdentity: CaseKey; source DeductionKey; farm+product+symptom, year. Customer identity is not returned.

actions.name: QUALITY_READ
actions.sideEffect: 기존 확정 불량 원장과 같은 연도 ViewWarehouse 입고를 읽기 전용으로 대조해 농장별 대차수 불량률, 차수별 품목 후보, 동일 차수 여러 주문의 동일 농장·품목 반복, 동일 농장 다품목 집중, 연속 차수 품목·농장 반복을 자동 감지한다. 자동 감지는 불량 원본 건수로 표시하고 거래처 식별정보는 반환하지 않으며 상세는 사용자가 펼칠 때만 보인다.

actions.name: QUALITY_EVENT
actions.sideEffect: 사용자가 이슈로 처리 또는 이력 저장을 명시적으로 눌렀을 때만 WebFarmQualityCase와 WebFarmQualityEvent를 기록한다.

criteria.source: confirmed active WebSalesDefectDeduction, original parent week, Quantity/OriginalQuantity; denominator is same-year ViewWarehouse OutQuantity by parent week, normalized FarmName, ProdKey and Product.OutUnit; no financial status filter
criteria.signals: SAME_ITEM_WEEK requires at least two distinct CustKey values for the same parent week+farm+product+unit; FARM_WEEK_CLUSTER requires at least two products for the same parent week+farm+unit; ITEM_PERSISTENT and FARM_RECURRING require adjacent weeks or three occurrences inside four parent weeks. Source count means distinct DeductionKey count, never customer count.
criteria.privacy: CustKey is selected only for server-side distinct-order detection and is never projected in groups, signals, cases or details. Expanded details contain parent/subweek, item, source count and quantity only.
criteria.units: rates and signals use exact original output unit; no box/bunch/stem conversion; missing or zero incoming denominator is shown as unknown, never 0 percent
criteria.rate: farm trend numerator is all confirmed defects for farm+unit+parent week and denominator is all ViewWarehouse incoming products for the same farm+unit+parent week; item candidate denominator additionally requires exact ProdKey
criteria.state: COMMENT preserves status; REQUEST creates unanswered round; RESPONSE only incoming/admin; APPLY requires answered; CLOSE manual; recurrence is suspected until reviewed
criteria.storage: automatic signals are a read-only projection of WebSalesDefectDeduction. WebFarmQualityCase+WebFarmQualityEvent are written only by explicit user action; immutable events, optimistic version and request idempotency
criteria.downstream: Estimate, Order, Shipment, Warehouse, Stock, WebProfitReport preserved

crossYearFixture.description: 2025 and 2026 same parent week are isolated
